title: Grateful Dead Live at Soldiers & Sailors Memorial Hall on 1979-02-09
lineage: 7" reel @ 3.75 ips (Akai GX-636) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz)> dBpoweramp 2496 > Adobe Audition CC 2014 > TLH flac2496

ai_review.summary: Boxy, bass‑poor audience recording of a great show.
ai_review.review: The reviewer describes the performance as a great show despite only being able to listen to a small portion. The AUD source is noted as very boxy and lacking low‑end, which limits the listening experience but doesn’t detract from the overall enjoyment of the music.

ai_rating.rationale: Review praises the show as great (high musical value) while calling out noticeable recording flaws (boxy, bassless). Weighted blend of strong show quality and fair recording quality yields a solid above‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Boxy sound with missing low frequencies; overall clarity limited, but audible enough to recognize the performance.
